scripts.audio: python3 audio/zone.py && python3 audio/noise.py && python3 audio/quiet.py && python3 audio/mix.py
scripts.render: remotion render QuietPromo out/video.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/video.mp4 -i public/score.mp3 -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest out/quiet-promo.mp4
scripts.x:edges: npm run x:segments && remotion render QuietPromo audio/out/x-edges.mp4 --scale=0.125 --crf=12 && python3 src/x/edges.py
scripts.render:x: remotion render QuietPromoX out/video-x.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/video-x.mp4 -i public/score-x.mp3 -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 256k -shortest out/quiet-promo-x.mp4
